name: texans-wallpaper-studio
description: Houston Texans Wallpaper Studio - client-side wallpaper composer

scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run library && npm run site && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.preview: npm run library && npm run site && npx wrangler dev
scripts.migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply texans-wallpaper-studio --remote
scripts.migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply texans-wallpaper-studio --local
